abu_dhabi_population_40_to_75.basis: Statistics Centre Abu Dhabi 2024 estimate as reproduced by citypopulation.de (https://www.citypopulation.de/en/uae/abudhabi/admin/): 40-49 811,235; 50-59 333,260; 60-69 101,990; 70-79 29,995. Ages 70 to 74 taken as 60 percent of the 70-79 band (about 18,000; the split is assumed). Sum 1,264,485. Third-party reproduction of the SCAD table; the SCAD portal itself could not be read. To verify at census.scad.gov.ae.
abu_dhabi_population_40_to_75.unit: residents aged 40 to 75, Abu Dhabi emirate, 2024

coordinator_cost_aed_per_hour.basis: Loaded cost of a screening or referral coordinator. The 120 is an assumption and looks high against the pay band in docs/evidence-wages.md section 5 (about AED 55 to 75 per hour loaded for a coordinator at about AED 6,500 a month, unless the model's coordinator is a nurse-coordinator); not re-estimated here. The wage ratios below are used only by the wage-weighted section of the script, which reports coordinator-equivalent minutes and does not convert them to AED.

fit_participation_annual.basis: Evidence for the level: 23.5 percent of 45,147 eligible Emirati nationals screened by FIT or gFOBT in 2015-2016 (BMC Cancer 2021, PMC8343888); regular screening below 20 percent in the general population (The National, 15 December 2024); 88 percent of over-40s in a UAE survey never screened (Khaleej Times, 9 March 2022, sponsor Sheikh Shakhbout Medical City). The high end is a programme target, not an observation. FIT is only one of three tests offered, so the FIT share is lower than overall screening.
fit_participation_annual.unit: share of the eligible population with a FIT result in a year

fit_positivity_market.basis: Gulf programmes: Qatar 6.8 percent (758 of 11,130, PMC9822526); Saudi Ministry of Health pilot 6.6 percent and Al-Kharj 6.3 percent (PMC11161890); Bahrain 716 of 11,000, 6.5 percent (MDPI Gastrointestinal Disorders 2024). Abu Dhabi ambulatory clinics 2015-2016 reported 13.5 percent among screened Emirati nationals (PMC8343888), used as the high end. Central 0.07 matches positivity_rate above.
fit_positivity_market.unit: share of FIT results that are positive

hosting_fixed_aed_per_month.basis: In-country hosting of the full stack with a standby copy (database, API, scheduler, watchdog, FHIR server, web). Not a quote.

hosting_variable_aed_per_1000_cases_per_.basis: Storage and compute growth with case volume. Not a quote.
hosting_variable_aed_per_1000_cases_per_.unit: AED per 1,000 actionable cases per year

licence_pathways.basis: FIT, blood-based colorectal, breast recall, cervical recall.

pilot_fit_screened_per_provider_per_year.basis: Placeholder until providers supply their real volumes (a data request in the pilot plan).
pilot_fit_screened_per_provider_per_year.unit: FIT results per provider per year

pilot_providers.basis: Pilot plan asks for two to three providers; the upper end is used.

positivity_rate.basis: Same value as simulator/params.yaml fit_positivity_rate (assumed there too; published ranges around 5-8 percent are to verify in docs/evidence.md).
positivity_rate.unit: share of screened members with a positive FIT

programme_licence_aed_per_year.basis: Illustrative: FIT positives, blood-based positives, breast recall and cervical recall for one programme owner. Set near the operator's modelled cost plus a margin, not against any benchmark.
programme_licence_aed_per_year.unit: AED per year, programme licence, four pathways, one emirate

shadow_days.basis: Length of the shadow-only run. Cases are not followed to closure by the engine, so no follow-up tail is funded.

shadow_governance_review_one_off_aed.basis: Data sharing agreement and security assessment for a read-only export; no clinical safety review of outbound wording. Lower than the 60,000 of the full pilot.

shadow_hosting_share_of_full.basis: A single copy without a standby, and no messaging or web channel. Applied to both the fixed and the variable hosting inputs.
shadow_hosting_share_of_full.unit: share of the full-stack hosting cost

shadow_integration_one_off_aed_per_provi.basis: Mapping and validating one periodic export (flat file or HL7 v2) per provider; no live interface, no outbound channel, no role set-up for messaging. Much lower than the 120,000 for a full integration. Not a quote.

shadow_licences_share_of_full.basis: Monitoring, backup and logging for a smaller footprint.
shadow_licences_share_of_full.unit: share of the third-party licence cost

shadow_support_fte.basis: Loading and checking the periodic export, tuning flags and a weekly review with the coordinator. Lower than the 1.0 FTE of the full pilot because nothing is sent or assigned.

support_fte_loaded_cost_aed_per_year.basis: Fully loaded engineer or support analyst cost.

third_party_licences_aed_per_year.basis: Monitoring, backup and logging tools. Excludes our own product fee, which is modelled separately under pricing.
